integrity: All mathematical claims are proved analytically; finite exact-rational computations test identities only. Originality is assessed against inspected public literature and a published-results search, not independently certified or guaranteed worldwide. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns two scalar strongly convex quadratic summands and stationary fair-marginal couplings of the two epoch permutations at fixed step size, conditional on \(|g|<1\). It does not classify feedback-dependent or nonstationary order control, intermediate within-epoch iterates, higher-dimensional models, or general nonlinear problems. Some optimal extreme policies are stationary but nonergodic.
title: Sharp stationary-risk envelope and order-phase switches for two-sample reshuffling
